summary: Tested email-first login and the Stripe sandbox pilot paywall from start to finish, on both the backend and the frontend. Backend: new pytest file /app/tests/test_billing_pilot.py, 12/12 pass. It sits outside backend/tests on purpose, so the conftest pilot auto-grant does not apply. Frontend: Playwright at 1920px and 390px, including a real hosted Stripe test checkout with card 4242. Every requested feature works. Only minor UX and code-quality items remain.
verified_passing: Login /login starts with only the email field and the 'Continue' button. The Organizer demo button, the Partner drop-down and Google are visible. The name, firm and password fields are collapsed (grid-rows-0fr, inert).

Unknown email: register-notice appears, the name, firm and password fields slide open, and the button reads 'Create account'. Known email (organizer@demo.assemble.test): only the password field opens and the button reads 'Sign in'. Wrong password shows signin-error 'Email or password is incorrect.' synthetic-demo signs in to /project (demo, no paywall). Editing the email returns the form to 'Continue'.
check-email API: exists true for a known email (case and whitespace are ignored), false for an unknown one, 422 for an invalid one.

A newly registered organizer lands on /pilot. All offer copy matches exactly: title, $99 one-time, 90 days, 5 bullets, 'Partners join free...', 'Continue to test checkout', the test-mode line and 'Try the demo'. Visiting /project redirects to /pilot. GET /api/project and POST /api/project return 402.

Checkout: the button redirects to checkout.stripe.com (Sandbox, US$99.00, 'Assemble pilot (90 days)', email prefilled). Paid with Card 4242 / 12/34 / 123 plus a billing address. /payment/success shows 'Confirming your payment…', then 'Pilot access active', 'Test payment complete. No money was charged.' and 'Access until Jan 23, 2027.' Open workspace goes to /project, and creating a job works.

After payment: signing out and back in lands on /project. The job persists after reload. /pilot redirects to /project. POST /api/billing/checkout returns 409. The DB holds exactly 1 transaction (paid/completed, $99), and the firm has pilot_until +90d, pilot_mode 'test' and pilot_session_id set.

Cancel path: the Stripe back arrow goes to /payment/cancel, which shows pilot-notice 'Checkout canceled. Your account is ready when you are.' and the offer again. Checking out again reuses the same cs_test session id, both via the UI and the API.

Security: GET /api/billing/status/<sid> returns 404 for another registered user, a demo organizer and a demo partner. /payment/success?session_id=fake shows 'Payment not found for your business.' and access stays inactive. A webhook with a bad signature returns 400. Unauthenticated billing calls return 401.

The demo organizer's /api/billing/access returns required:false, demo:true, and /pilot redirects that user to /project. Demo checkout returns 400. A partner demo (Alder) lands on /reviews, and /pilot and /payment/cancel redirect to /reviews.
'Try the demo' signs the user out (/api/auth/me returns 401) and goes to /login, where the Organizer demo works.
Mobile 390px: the login register step and the pilot offer have no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390).

minor.issue: origin_url comes from the client and is used unvalidated in success_url and cancel_url, so Stripe can redirect to any domain after checkout (open redirect). Validate it against an allowed list (env FRONTEND origin / CORS origins).
The stripe-python calls (Session.retrieve/create, Price.list) are synchronous inside async handlers and block the event loop. Wrap them in run_in_threadpool or use the async client (retrieve_async).
When a pending session has expired at Stripe, a new session is created, but the old transaction stays payment_status 'pending' forever (it is only marked expired via the status poll or the webhook).
Allows unlimited account enumeration with no rate limit. This is inherent to email-first UX, but consider throttling per IP.

ui_bugs.issue: /payment/success?session_id=fake (or any error) shows only the red error text, with no button back to /pilot or /project. The user is stuck.

issues: The collapsed Reveal blocks still take space-y-4 gaps, so the space between the email field and Continue (and between email and password in the sign-in step) is noticeably larger than the other gaps.
The Organizer/Partner demo panel unmounts after Continue, so the whole card jumps vertically. register-notice sits below the 'Create account' button; it would read better above the fields.

action_items: Validate origin_url in /api/billing/checkout against allowed origins (open redirect).
Move synchronous Stripe SDK calls off the event loop (run_in_threadpool or *_async methods).
Mark superseded expired pending transactions as expired when creating a new checkout session.
Add a 'Back to pilot' / 'Open workspace' action in the PaymentSuccess error state.
Optional polish: even out the login spacing when Reveal blocks are collapsed (e.g. move the margins inside the Reveal content), and consider moving register-notice above the fields.
critical_code_review_comments: fulfil() is properly idempotent: it checks amount, currency, metadata firm_id and payment_status, and uses a conditional update_one guard. Good.
The status endpoint scopes the lookup by firm_id, so cross-tenant reads return 404. Good.
PaymentSuccess polls 10 times at 2s, then shows the pending state with a refresh option. Good.
Login.jsx uses inert='' on hidden Reveal blocks, so hidden required fields are not focusable. Good.
seed_data_creation: Registered several TEST_pilot_*@example.com / TEST_other_* organizers (password Passw0rd!x). TEST_pilot_1792903243@example.com is PAID (session cs_test_a1xgFLy00xCYkrIRLMHCd62YprZF94sD1Fei1VC2vCVmTBn8ObK2JpGSdY) and has a job 'TEST pilot job'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Billing tests live in /app/tests (not backend/tests, whose conftest monkeypatches requests to grant the pilot on register). Stripe checkout automation tips: click the Card radio with page.mouse.click on the #payment-method-label-card bounding box (a normal click is intercepted by the accordion button); fill #cardNumber, #cardExpiry, #cardCvc, #billingName and #billingAddressLine1 (press Escape to close the Google suggestions), then #billingLocality, #billingPostalCode and #billingAdministrativeArea; UNCHECK #enableStripePass (the Link save option requires a phone number and keeps Pay disabled); then click [data-testid=hosted-payment-submit-button]. The back arrow is a[href*='/payment/cancel'].
